Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — excited to move forward. Before we sign the reseller addendum, our legal and security teams have a couple of straightforward asks:

- Can you provide a current list of Redwood subprocessors that will be in the data path for the reseller flow (particularly any edge/CDN or caching providers used by resellers)?
- For each subprocessor, can you confirm the country(ies) of processing and whether any caching or TLS termination will occur outside the EU?
- If you rely on any subcontracted vendors via the reseller (i.e., the reseller uses their own CDN that touches customer content), will Redwood add those vendors to your subprocessor list or will they remain under the reseller's control?

These items are gating for our procurement/legal team. If easier, we can hop on a short call — otherwise a CSV or summary will do.

Best,
Tom

Hi all — attaching the subprocessors inventory and a short mapping specific to the reseller flow. Summary below (see CSV for full fields):

- EdgeFjord CDN Ltd (edgefjord.com) — Role: CDN / edge caching + optional TLS termination. Processing locations: EU (FI, DE) + US (us-east-1) depending on routing. Impact: If the reseller routes through EdgeFjord's US POPs, customer payloads may transit to US. EdgeFjord is not directly contracted by Redwood for this reseller; the reseller currently uses EdgeFjord as their CDN provider.
- Tracklytics Inc — Role: analytics/usage metrics (aggregated). Processing locations: EU only.
- LogStack Solutions — Role: telemetry/log aggregation for platform health. Processing locations: EU (primary) with encrypted replication to EU backups.
- Redwood KMS (customer keys) — Role: key management; keys are customer-managed and stored in GCP eu-west1 when customers choose EU residency.

Attachments: subprocessors_inventory.csv (attached) — contains columns: vendor, role, contact, countries, attestation/SOC2 status, last-reviewed.

Recommendation: for NordicResell we should either require EdgeFjord to provide an attestation and SOC2 report before being added to our public roster, or ask the reseller to configure EU-only origin/POP routing for these customers. I’ve flagged this to Legal as well.

Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Reseller integration: subprocessor scope & countries of processing

Thanks Marissa — helpful breakdown. A couple of security notes for procurement/legal consideration: 

- If EdgeFjord POPs in the US are in the data path, we have cross-border transit to the US which may trigger additional contractual controls (SCCs, DPA addendum language, data subject routing guarantees).
- Before we add EdgeFjord to our official subprocessor roster, we should obtain: (a) their most recent SOC2 Type II report or equivalent, (b) a signed data processing attestation that clarifies POP routing options (EU-only for specified customers), and (c) confirmation on TLS termination points and key custody (EdgeFjord indicates they can optionally TLS-terminate but can be configured for TLS passthrough).
- For short-term deals where the reseller insists on using their existing CDN, we can accept a reseller attestation (reseller contractually guarantees EU-only routing) plus an indemnity for routing misconfiguration. Long-term, prefer vendor onboarding into our roster.

Related: I’ve dropped a draft checklist in the Drive folder (link below). Once we have EdgeFjord's SOC2 and attestation, Security will sign off.

Aditya Rao
Sr. InfoSec Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Tom / Legal team — thanks for the patience. To summarize next steps and proposed path forward:

1) We’ve attached the current subprocessors CSV and a short note on EdgeFjord routing (see edgefjord_eu_routing_note.pdf). If NordicResell prefers, we can ask EdgeFjord to complete Redwood’s vendor questionnaire and provide SOC2 evidence; alternatively the reseller can provide a contractual attestation guaranteeing EU-only routing for affected customers.

2) Redwood will prepare a short DPA addendum for reseller flows that includes: subprocessor roster, routing commitments, and a reciprocal attestation clause. Draft attached: redwood_dpa_addendum_draft.docx.

3) Security (Aditya) has requested SOC2 type II + attestation before we add EdgeFjord to our public roster. If procurement needs faster timelines, we can accept a reseller attestation for an initial onboarding but will require remediation/onsite evidence within 90 days.

4) Can we schedule a 30-minute call early next week to align on which option you prefer (vendor onboarding vs reseller attestation) and finalize the addendum? I’m available Mon/Tue morning CET.

Tom — if you confirm the preferred path I’ll push the DPA addendum and a checklist over to your legal team and track next steps in HubSpot (hs-deal-8342).
